analytic_method: Common tangents between signed circles, clockwise rib-side wraps and counterclockwise backside wraps, joined as a closed planar wire. One swept section contains backing and all six ribs.
normalization: Five grooved pulley candidates repair their outer bands and receive common PK comparison grooves. Outside diameters, stations, internal webs and mounting interfaces are preserved. Smooth tensioner/water-pump wheels are not grooved.
limits: Current outside radii are not verified effective radii; the diagnostic residual is not a production belt sizing result.
The CAD cord path and catalog effective length use different reference conventions and are not asserted equal.
No accessory center is moved merely to fit the nominal catalog length.
Traction, tension, spring travel, belt elasticity, speed ratios and dynamic bending remain unvalidated.
A coherent solid routing study is not completion of the installed belt fit.
